properties.decision:
reflow2 will not check that a dependency named in your design or your code is real. It does not resolve package registries, read a language server, or import anything. A capability can name `numpy.frobnicate()` and reflow2 will record it, thread it, and report on it exactly as it would a real one.

WHOSE JOB IT IS: a package manager (`pip check`, `npm ls`, `cargo tree`), a language server, or a type checker. Those resolve names against reality; reflow2 resolves names against the DESIGN.

⚠️ WHY THIS IS WRITTEN DOWN RATHER THAN LEFT SILENT. Anthony named hallucinated dependencies as a top AI-agent pitfall on 2026-08-17, and reflow2's own description — a design brain that keeps a project coherent — invites the assumption that it is watching. It is not. A clean health report and a hallucinated import are entirely compatible, and the clean report would be TRUE while the inference drawn from it was false. That is the vacuous-zero failure `epoch:instruments-stop-overstating` exists to end, arriving through absence rather than through a bad number.

⇒ WHAT REFLOW2 DOES DO NEARBY, so this is a boundary and not a shrug: `declare_dependency` records what the design says it depends on, and `reconcile_dependencies` compares that against what was OBSERVED in the build. So reflow2 can tell you the build imports something the design never declared — the design-boundary half of the problem — while claiming nothing about whether the thing exists in the world.

RECORDED AS A NON-GOAL, 2026-08-17. A non-goal is a statement about the CURRENT build, not a promise about the future: if this is ever built, retiring this decision is part of shipping it. A stale non-goal is a false statement in the opposite direction, which is the failure AGENTS.md committed by telling a reader that a `/mcp` reconnect picks up a rebuild.
properties.name: NON-GOAL — reflow2 does not verify that a named package, library or method EXISTS
properties.rationale: reflow2 resolves names against the design, never against the world. Silence on that boundary reads as coverage, and a clean health report beside a hallucinated import would be true while the inference from it was false — absence producing the same harm as a vacuous zero. Written down so the assumption cannot be made quietly.
